Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's highest DP Digimon.

[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 5 or more memory, their Digimon effects don't affect this Digimon until their turn ends. Then, if they have 5 or less, their Option effects don't affect this Digimon until their turn ends.
